description:
The near future. Falling marriage rates, shrinking population.  
Marriage is no longer love, but an investment.  
"That investment, we're here to help."

"Marriage simulation" that simulates a future married to the other person.  
Couples contemplating marriage are forced to see each other's true colors.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=811716), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9821901)
